g.text: 🚁 Drones Controller — Autonomous Flight Control Pipeline
Geometric SO(3), Error-State EKF & DMDc Optimal Control Integrated with ArduPilot DDS SITL & Gazebo
• Auto Position Hold on stick release
• Tracking error: ep = pd - p, ev = vd - v
a_d = p̈_d + K_p e_p + K_v e_v
• Force: Fd = m(ad - g e3) • Desired Rd ∈ SO(3)
• Error state: δx = [δp, δv, δθ, δω]ᵀ ∈ ℝ¹²
• Discrete Riccati solve: P = AᵀPA + Q
• Rejects NaN / Inf ➔ Safe zero vel
• Z < 0.50m: Zero lateral drift until clear
📍 WHERE IT IS USED & REAL-WORLD DEPLOYMENT PIPELINE
• Autonomous Waypoint Tracking in GPS / GPS-denied • Direct Controller Benchmarking • Hardware Flight Stack (Pixhawk FCU + FastRTPS)
SYSTEM STATUS: ✓ 15/15 Automated Unit Tests Passing
🔁 Closed-Loop Feedback: Gazebo SITL Kinematics / Pixhawk IMU ➔ AP_DDS State Estimation @ 50 Hz
